AI-edited video of Jacqueline Fernandez's 'Jugni' clip alleged

Singer Sonu Thukral has claimed that a video showing actress Jacqueline Fernandez experiencing a wardrobe malfunction during the filming of the song 'Jugni' was edited using artificial intelligence. Thukral stated this in a complaint filed with the authorities. The claim suggests the incident, if it occurred, was not genuine but a fabrication.
